subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A × B' means ‘A is the son of B’,

'A − B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A + B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M × N % P + S − T’?
solution:

Given Expression: M × N % P + S − T

M is son of N, N is father of P, P is wife of S and S is brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1878822ce8e8e40d3fdeb5094b5713ed5ecb3246150297884e74d29364d3231a.png] 

M is T's Brother's wife's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
